2607.12463.title: Function-Aware Fill-in-the-Middle as Mid-Training for Coding Agent Foundation Models
2607.12463.paper_summary: Coding agents must integrate external tool returns into ongoing reasoning - a capability that standard left-to-right pretraining on code exposes only in its forward direction. We observe that the action-observation-continuation loop of a coding agent is structurally isomorphic to a function call site, where a caller binds arguments, a callee returns a value computed elsewhere, and downstream code consumes that value. This conditioning structure exists at internet scale in ordinary code. We exploit it through function-aware fill-in-the-middle (FIM) mid-training: a self-supervised objective that masks functions selected via program dependency graph analysis and a complexity-inferability double criterion. We mid-train Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct (7B/14B) and Qwen3-8B on a 2.6B-token decontaminated corpus drawn from 968 GitHub repositories, then apply existing agentic post-training pipelines. Mid-training improves SWE-Bench-Verified by +2.8/+3.0 at 7B/14B and by +3.2 on Qwen3-8B; SWE-Bench-Lite gains are +3.7/+4.0/+5.4 on the same models. The improvement holds across two post-training pipelines (R2E-Gym, SWE-Smith) and on a non-Qwen2.5 base (Qwen3-8B with SWE-Lego). Beyond in-domain gains, mid-training also mitigates the capability erosion that agentic post-training otherwise inflicts on non-agent coding (e.g., LiveCodeBench) and non-coding tool-use benchmarks (tau-bench, BFCL): although the mid-training corpus contains Python code only, the function-call inductive bias survives post-training and yields consistent gains.
2607.12463.paper_summary_zh: 編碼代理必須將外部工具的回饋整合到持續的推理中——這是一種標準的從左到右的代碼預訓練僅在其前向方向上暴露的能力。<lb/>我們觀察到，編碼代理的行動-觀察-延續循環在結構上與函數調用位置同構，其中調用者綁定參數，被調用者返回在其他地方計算的值，而下游代碼消耗該值。<lb/>這種條件結構在互聯網規模的普通代碼中存在。<lb/>我們通過函數感知的中訓練（FIM）來利用它：這是一種自我監督的目標，通過程序依賴圖分析和複雜性-可推斷性雙重標準來掩蓋選定的函數。<lb/>我們在從968個GitHub存儲庫中提取的26億標記的去污染語料庫上對Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct（7B/14B）和Qwen3-8B進行中訓練，然後應用現有的代理後訓練管道。<lb/>中訓練使SWE-Bench-Verified在7B/14B上提高了+2.8/+3.0，在Qwen3-8B上提高了+3.2；SWE-Bench-Lite在同一模型上的增益為+3.7/+4.0/+5.4。<lb/>這一改進在兩個後訓練管道（R2E-Gym，SWE-Smith）和非Qwen2.5基礎（Qwen3-8B與SWE-Lego）上均成立。<lb/>除了領域內的增益外，中訓練還減輕了代理後訓練對非代理編碼（例如，LiveCodeBench）和非編碼工具使用基準（tau-bench，BFCL）所造成的能力侵蝕：儘管中訓練語料庫僅包含Python代碼，但函數調用的歸納偏見在後訓練中仍然存在並產生一致的增益。
